title: BEIR: A Heterogeneous Benchmark for Zero-shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Hole@10 rate (the percentage of top-10 retrieved documents that have not been judged by human annotators) and performing manual annotation on unjudged candidate documents to re-compute retrieval metrics (nDCG@10) and assess how candidate pooling methods unfairly disadvantage non-lexical (dense neural) retrieval systems.
